newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Buy Sweden 2000 Ecu bond.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Buy Sweden 2000 Ecu bond.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' Eurobond latest trade recommendations centred on French francs, dollars and yen.

Sanwa International recommends switching out of the Sweden 7.25 percent French franc Eurobond due June 2000 and switching into its 7.25 percent Ecu bond due May 2000, picking up 53 basis points in yield.

"The more conciliatory tone by the French socialist government with regards to EMU, means that the Amsterdam summit could result in more convergence between high and low yielding European bond markets" Sanwa said.
"If EMU is perceived to take place on time in 1999, the spread between these two bonds should narrow close to parity," it said.
